categories.main_business_segments: CGN New Energy Holdings Co., Ltd. primarily operates in power generation, focusing on renewable and clean energy sources including wind, solar, gas-fired, hydro, fuel cell, biomass, coal-fired, oil-fired, and cogeneration projects. The company also provides management services to power plants operated by CGN and its subsidiaries. Its operations span power generation, construction, and operation of power stations and associated facilities in China and Korea.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in offshore wind power, including large-scale pile-supported fixed deep water offshore photovoltaic projects and floating offshore wind turbines. It develops intelligent operation and maintenance equipment for unmanned power station operation and uses digital twins and intelligent forecasting tools. In energy storage, it focuses on electrochemical, molten salt, compressed air, liquid flow, and heat storage technologies. The company also integrates safety and health monitoring platforms for lithium-ion battery storage stations and wind power equipment health status prediction technology.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are electricity offtakers, including government grid companies and power exchanges, notably Korea Power Exchange (KPX) in Korea. The main suppliers are fuel providers such as Korea Gas Corporation (KOGAS). The company serves the power markets in China and Korea, supplying electricity and steam to various industrial, commercial, and residential users through grid connections.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across 19 provinces, two autonomous regions, and one municipality in China, and also has significant operations in Korea. Its installed capacity is approximately 79.3% in China and 20.7% in Korea. The company’s headquarters and principal place of business are in Hong Kong.
categories.supply_chain_position: CGN New Energy Holdings operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power generation and supply. It owns and operates power plants and energy storage facilities, and provides management services to power plants, positioning itself as a power producer and service provider rather than an upstream fuel supplier.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes high-quality development, safety, and innovation, focusing on technological integration in offshore wind and solar power, digital operation and maintenance, and energy storage technologies. It emphasizes independent innovation, green development models, and the transformation of R&D achievements into market applications. The company also invests in smart microgrids, virtual power plants, and safety monitoring platforms, aiming to enhance competitiveness and support the dual-carbon goals.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of electricity and steam, tariff income, capacity charges, service income on electricity sales, management service income, and sales of renewable energy certificates. The company recognizes revenue primarily at the point of electricity or steam delivery, with credit terms ranging from 30 to 90 days. It also receives government grants and compensation income related to fuel cell projects.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, CGN New Energy Holdings positions itself as a leading player in the renewable energy sector in China and Korea, with a diversified portfolio and a strong focus on innovation and high-quality development. It holds a significant market share in wind and solar power generation and has received multiple industry awards recognizing its operational excellence and growth potential.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: As of 2024, the company’s attributable installed capacity reached 10,452.4 MW, an 8.6% increase year-on-year. Revenue for 2024 was US$1,951.3 million, a decrease of 11.0% from the previous year, with operating profit of US$528.3 million and profit attributable to equity shareholders of US$248.0 million. The company’s total assets were US$8.72 billion with total equity of US$1.76 billion. Despite some revenue decline, the company maintains steady growth in installed capacity and continues capital expenditure expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes high-quality, safe, and efficient power generation with a diversified energy portfolio including advanced offshore wind and solar technologies, and innovative energy storage solutions. It differentiates itself through technological innovation, digital operation and maintenance capabilities, and strong environmental, social, and governance (ESG) practices. Its commitment to supporting China’s dual-carbon goals and providing reliable, clean energy underpins its competitive advantage.
